what_changed: First run, so there is no previous note to compare against. Oil and gold have fallen hard over the past month, chips and pharma are near their highs, and VIX is low. No family had a named catalyst, so every family is flat.

gold_miners.why: Gold is weak, the dollar is firm and the Fed leans hawkish; NEM's Q2 call is only a scheduled event.

chips.why: The sector rally is already priced in and no NVDA-specific catalyst was found.

pharma.why: LLY is near its high and no trial or approval news was found.

copper_uranium.why: The leader FCX has no copper catalyst; the Cigar Lake news is about uranium.
